scripts.sync: docker compose exec backend /bin/bash -c "curl -s http://localhost:5000/swagger/v1/swagger.json > JobHuntX.API/swagger.json && cd JobHuntX.API && dotnet nswag run nswag.local.json"
scripts.format: docker compose exec backend /bin/bash -c "dotnet format && cd client-app && npx prettier --write ."
scripts.validate: docker compose exec backend /bin/bash -c "dotnet format --verify-no-changes && cd client-app && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && dotnet test && pnpm test"
scripts.check: docker compose exec backend /bin/bash -c "dotnet format --verify-no-changes && cd client-app && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck"
scripts.local:sync: curl -s http://localhost:5000/swagger/v1/swagger.json > JobHuntX.API/swagger.json && cd JobHuntX.API && dotnet nswag run nswag.local.json
scripts.local:format: dotnet format && cd client-app && npx prettier --write .
scripts.local:init: npm install && dotnet tool restore && npm run init:env
scripts.init:env: cp JobHuntX.API/.env.sample JobHuntX.API/.env -n || true && cp client-app/.env.sample client-app/.env -n || true
